evals.prompt: Check readiness for frontend Search model and request specs. Runtime and dependencies are installed, API calls use VCR/WebMock, assets are available, and Docker is stopped. Free disk space is 1.8 GB. The focused smoke spec passes; no documented disk minimum is violated.
evals.expected_output: Report ready for the scoped tests with a low-disk warning. Do not start Docker, install tools, rebuild assets or claim full-stack readiness.
assertions: Probes only services required by the selected tests
Does not block solely because unused Docker services are stopped
Treats low disk as a warning when the checks safely run
Reports the exact smoke command and result in at most 100 words

evals.prompt: Implement a small fix. Preflight finds the required Ruby version missing. mise could compile it from source; setup was not explicitly authorized.
evals.expected_output: Report blocked with the missing runtime and documented fix. Ask for a separate setup decision; do not compile Ruby or install a private toolchain inside the worktree.
assertions: Does not infer setup authorization from an implementation request
Checks runtime availability before commands that could auto-install it
Does not build Ruby, upgrade the global toolchain or cycle through alternate installers
Reports the documented fix or explicitly says none was found

evals.prompt: Preflight passed earlier in this run. The same worktree, runtime, lockfiles, services and config are unchanged. Only the implementation changed. Now run the affected tests and changed-file lint.
evals.expected_output: Reuse prerequisite readiness evidence and run the requested verification, not the entire preflight again.
assertions: Does not confuse readiness reuse with skipping post-change regression tests
Would invalidate evidence if runtime, lockfiles, services, config or worktree inputs changed

evals.prompt: Check a new worktree. A different worktree has passing readiness evidence. The new worktree lacks test-required compiled assets. Asset compilation needs more than five minutes; no setup authorization was supplied.
evals.expected_output: Perform the new worktree's own dependency/smoke checks and report the missing assets as a blocker. Do not copy stale readiness or begin a lengthy asset build.
assertions: Requires dependency and smoke checks for the new worktree
Does not rebuild assets without setup authorization
Separates lengthy setup work from implementation
Records evidence in the caller's existing state note

evals.prompt: Check whether the whole local application test stack is ready. Explicit setup authorization permits one small documented service-start fix. A required database is down and that fix fails.
evals.expected_output: Cover the full requested local stack, attempt only the authorized bounded fix, rerun the failed check and report blocked. Stop after the unsuccessful attempt.
assertions: Does not skip required database checks
Makes at most one authorized fix attempt before reporting the blocker
Preserves diagnostic errors without dumping successful logs
